_comment: Frame 6, one per scent — and genuinely different content per scent, not a duplicate: Coconut Breeze lists 7 lotion ingredients including the coconut oil extract, Pure Unscented lists 6. The comparison column is identical in both.

images.alt: An ingredient comparison. The Coconut Breeze Body Lotion has 7 ingredients: purified spring water, organic virgin coconut oil, organic jojoba, plant-based emulsifying wax, organic grapefruit seed extract, organic red palm oil, organic coconut oil extract. The Body Cream has 8. Beside it, the published list of a conventional coconut oil lotion, which has 34.
